individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each point is already an individual sample measurement (n=141 samples); marginal histograms show distributions. No averaging obscures raw data.
Scatter plot; each marker represents a cell-line/reporter mean with error bars, individual points not required for scatter-type plots.
Line/density plots showing fitted distributions; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Box plot (exempt by type) that additionally overlays individual sample data points (colored dots) on top of each box.
Polar histograms display the distribution of underlying phase-difference measurements themselves, analogous to a histogram/violin plot, so individual point overlay is not required.
Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences; histogram-type plot showing distribution, exempt from individual point requirement.
Line plot illustrating an example fit to a single signal trace; line plots are exempt from the individual data point requirement.
Scatter plot where each marker is an individual sample/cell-line mean with error bars; scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional individual point overlay.
